title: ExportProviderResult
description: Result envelope every export provider (Pandoc, Typst, pptxgenjs, LibreOffice, sanitized-HTML, ...) returns for one RichDocument-to-format conversion. Defined by construct-tsyfe.6.1 (ADR-0073 RichDocument IR); no existing exporter is wired to emit this shape yet — see lib/export-provider-contract.mjs for the hand-rolled validator (ADR-0001: no Ajv/zod in core) and construct-tsyfe.6.2 for production wiring.

ok.description: Whether the export produced a usable output file.

format.description: Output format identifier (e.g. pdf, docx, pptx, html) — the same vocabulary lib/rich-document-export.mjs's RICH_EXPORT_FORMATS declares.

outputPath.description: Absolute path to the written output file.

provider.description: Identity of the engine that produced the output — never the Construct module name, the external tool/library (pandoc, typst, pptxgenjs, libreoffice, ...).

contentHash.description: sha256 of the output file's bytes only (lib/export-provider-contract.mjs hashExportOutput) — never a filesystem path or environment-derived value, so two runs are comparable independent of which engine produced the file.

fidelity.description: What survived the RichDocument-to-output conversion, derived from the provider's declared per-format block coverage (ExportProviderCapabilities) diffed against the input document's real block-type inventory — not asserted in prose.

degraded.description: True whenever droppedBlocks is non-empty — a caller can rely on this flag alone without re-deriving it from the array length.
